title: Knight Rider
description: A programmable sci-fi light scanner with six patterns, custom paths, color, voice, complete reduced-motion behavior, and touch-safe programming.

title: Loading State
description: A calm, specific progress surface that shows what is happening and lets people pause or advance it.

title: Thinking
description: A readable trace of completed reasoning steps with details available on demand.

title: Streaming Text
description: A progressive answer with visible sources and a clear continuation control.

title: Approval Card
description: A decision surface that makes an agent stop, explain the choices, and wait for approval.

title: Tool Chips
description: Compact, inspectable summaries of files read, changes made, and checks completed.

title: Task Rows
description: Live task states that separate completed work, current work, and attention needed.

title: Chat
description: A compact project conversation with readable turns and a working composer.

title: Prompt Bar
description: A roomy prompt composer for context, model choice, dictation, and submission.

title: Recommendation Card
description: A recommendation with visible confidence and explicit accept or save actions.

title: Context Cards
description: Source cards that reveal the evidence behind an answer without losing provenance.

title: Diff Table
description: A field-by-field review of current and proposed values with selective acceptance.

title: Records Table
description: A tactile records grid with sorting, selection, owners, stages, and value.

title: Filter Table
description: A compact records view whose visible results respond immediately to status choices.

title: Sidebar Nav
description: A complete workspace rail with search, destinations, counts, and a user control.

title: Search
description: Fast live filtering across actions and workspace destinations, including a useful empty state.

title: Insight Cards
description: A paged insight surface that joins a clear conclusion to a compact chart.

title: Code Block
description: A readable code surface that can reveal work progressively and copy the finished result.

title: Fine-tune Card
description: A live inspector for adjusting corners, spacing, and type weight against the real result.

title: Selection Actions
description: A focused rewrite bar that applies clear text transformations and preserves an immediate reset.
